description:
In Episode 223 we discuss the election of the new pope, Leo and the significance of him choosing the name Leo XIV. There were two sieges of Jerusalem before its destruction in AD70 and these events serve as a type of the destruction that will take place before the second coming of Jesus. Similarly, there will be two attempts to pressurise God’s people, the spiritual Jerusalem, to submit to a false standard of worship. During the reign of pope Leo the XIIIth attempts were made to introduce labour and enforced Sunday legislation and the pope wrote the encyclical Rerum Novarum that set the tone for the Catholic doctrine on social justice. Did the new pope signal his intention to complete this work by adopting the name Leo the XIVth?  Are we heading for a second siege?  Time will tell. Get ready, get ready, get ready.
